subject: Materials Science
title: The Diamond Cubic Structure
description: A quick, practical guide to The Diamond Cubic Structure.

hook.text: Diamond is the hardest natural material — and its secret is a very open crystal structure.

buildup.text: Diamond cubic is FCC with four extra atoms inside — each carbon bonds tetrahedrally to four neighbors.

discovery.text: Only 34% packed — lots of empty space — but those four covalent bonds per atom are incredibly strong.

twist.text: Silicon has the same diamond cubic structure — its electronic behavior makes computers possible.

climax.text: Germanium, silicon, and diamond all share this structure — from jewelry to microchips.

punchline.text: A half-empty crystal held together by the strongest bonds in nature.

quiz.question: What is the packing efficiency of diamond cubic?
